description: This file appears to be a configuration module (probably for a bundler like Rollup) specifying input files, output targets, alias resolutions, and dependency validation for a project involving UI components and assets. It sets up module paths, resolves dependencies, and exports configuration parameters.

methods.name: resolveUiDependency
methods.description: Resolves the path for a UI dependency module by checking its presence in designated node_modules directories. Throws an error if the module cannot be resolved.
